properties.site-address: Lock Up Garage Site May Street/lower Brook Street Brookvale Basingstoke
properties.notes: Full planning permission (15/04189/FUL) was granted in March 2017 for 12 affordable units. The site has been sold by the council and the new owners Sovereign and construction has started on sites with completions expected in 2018/19. The site is deliverable within five years.. Erection of 12 no. dwellings to provide affordable housing (4 no. 1-bed flats & 8 no. 2-bed houses) with associated parking and landscaping following demolition of existing lock-up garages
